description: This is a Java class defining constants used in an Android wearable geofencing application. It includes static final variables for tags, IDs, actions, and timeout values which are used throughout the app for identifying geofences, handling notifications, and performing actions.

classes.name: Constants
classes.description: A final utility class containing constant values used across the wearable geofencing app.
